_comment: Calibrated design artifacts for the KDP Publishing Copilot. Single source of truth for brand palette, typography, and how emblems are placed on covers. Consumed by logo_design.py (emblem generation) and kdp_print.py (cover assembly).

typography.title: serif — Times-Bold (built-in) or Libre Baskerville if bundled

5x8.note: compute exact values via: kdp_print.py specs --size 5x8 --pages N

8.5x11.note: compute exact values via: kdp_print.py specs --size 8.5x11 --pages N
